نتفارق (form VI)
# نَتَفَارَقُ (natafāraqu) /na.ta.faː.ra.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَفَارَقَ (tafāraqa)
# نَتَفَارَقَ (natafāraqa) /na.ta.faː.ra.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَفَارَقَ (tafāraqa)
# نَتَفَارَقْ (natafāraq) /na.ta.faː.raq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَفَارَقَ (tafāraqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
